messages:
anna (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock the next 2-week iteration split between immediate bug backlog vs customer-driven enhancements. Short poll please:

Choices:
A) 1st week bugs, 2nd week features
B) Mix daily (2 devs on bugs)
C) Feature-first, roll fixes into hotfix patch

Context: launch metrics look stable (GAU +8% MoM), but we have 14 open regressions flagged by CS (priority mix: 2 P0, 4 P1). See tickets: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-3345 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-3390

raj (Eng): I'm +A. Two P0s need immediate attention to keep SLA. Can hotfix the P0s in the first 48h and then rotate squad to features.

sarah (Eng): +B. Continuous bug triage prevents context switching later. Proposal: daily bug-shift for 2 engineers, rest focus on rollout items.

tess (CS): Customer priority here — two enterprise customers hit P0s. They asked for timelines. If we do A, can we commit to ship fix within 72h for P0s?

mike (Design): If we block a full week for bugs we risk delaying the UX improvements slated for the feature milestone. Can we scope the features to MLP (minimal) and push stretch?

deploy-bot: New deploy scheduled: canary to prod at 1934568000 UTC. CI report: 1 failing e2e (related to RED-3390)

anna (PM): Proposed compromise: Do A for first 72h (P0s + critical P1s), then B for remainder (two devs on triage). Features go MLP only. Acceptable to CS? We’ll update customers with a targeted ETA.

tess (CS): Yes, we can communicate 72h ETA for P0s and daily status updates. I'll draft messages.

raj (Eng): I'll take RED-3345 (P0). Sarah will own the bug-shift rota. Can we freeze non-critical merges during first 72h?

sarah (Eng): Freeze + bug-standup 09:30 daily, 15m. I'll post rota in #eng-oncall.

anna (PM): OK locked. Action items:
- Raj: P0 RED-3345 (ETA 48-72h)
- Sarah: create rota + daily standup
- Tess: customer comms + status doc
- Mike: scope-features to MLP and list deps
- Ops: set merge freeze tag

Please react with :thumbsup: to approve or :question: to flag.

raj (Eng): :thumbsup:

sarah (Eng): :thumbsup:

tess (CS): :thumbsup:

mike (Design): :thumbsup:

anna (PM): Thanks all — will post updated plan and Jira sprint config after this thread.
